gaps.explanation: detail[] holds every General Fund revenue line from the General Fund departments statement (trimmed p11-12): 1,109,519 + Sale of assets 13,389 + Interest income 16,872 + 5,488 = 1,145,268. The governmental funds statement (pp4-5) also prints four other fund columns, and none of their revenue rows are in detail[]. The p10 all-funds budget schedule gives these funds' spending only. Missing amounts: Street, total revenues 250,835 (Property taxes 1,917 + Motor vehicle 30,223 + Highway allocation 205,162 + Highway incentive 3,000 + Motor vehicle fees 10,254 + Licenses and permits 300 + Other (21)) plus Interest income 100 (p5). Keno, Keno proceeds 13,541 plus Interest income 3,718. LB840 Economic Development, Sales tax - LB840 104,622 + Interlocal agreements 1,668 (rows add to 106,290; printed total 106,291). LB840 Infrastructure, Sales tax - LB840 210,142 plus Interest income 4,133. Added: 250,935 + 17,259 + 106,290 + 214,275 = 588,759. Check: 1,145,268 + 588,759 = 1,734,027 vs statement 1,734,028, a difference of 1 from the report's own rounding in the LB840 Economic Development column.

gaps.explanation: The statement figure comes from the accrual proprietary statement (p7): Total operating expenses 600,720 (includes Depreciation and amortization 203,140) + Interest and fees expense 24,948 = 625,668. The JSON line sum is 625,667 because the report rounds. detail[] holds the p10 budgetary-basis all-funds schedule actuals: Water 857,108 + Wastewater 142,682 + Sanitation 170,976 = 1,170,766. Those actuals include capital outlay and debt principal, and the schedule's debt service is printed on a separate all-funds row, while depreciation is excluded. By fund: Water 857,108 vs p7 283,914 + 14,854 = 298,768; Sewer 142,682 vs 156,110 + 10,094 = 166,204; Sanitation 170,976 vs 160,696. The two printed bases differ by 1,170,766 - 625,667 = 545,099, so there is no fix.
